In summary, our research is concerned with

the following three main aspects: 1) we propose a multi channel transformer network to leverage the spatial and temporal information for speech recognition, 2) we propose a channel wise self attention layer and a cross channel attention layer to encode the contextual relationship between channels, 3) we conduct extensive experiments on a far field in-house dataset to demonstrate that our proposed method can significantly improve the performance of single channel transformer and the baseline beamforming based methods.
